title: When the gate write guard overturns a user's Accept, the approval card turns Rejected with no reason shown in TermAl
outcome: When the gate guard's delayed-approval re-check denies a request a user accepted, TermAl records the reason on the approval message or as a session notice: which gate, and when it is released. The user sees why the request was rejected.
acceptance: When the gate write guard overturns a user's Accept, the approval card turns Rejected with no reason shown in TermAl is done
